title.romaji: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?)
title.english: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless…
title.native: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ! (※ムリじゃなかった!?)

synonyms: ให้เป็นแฟนได้ไง ไม่เอาไม่ไหวหรอก (※หรือว่าจะไหวนะ!?)
description:
Renako Amaori is leaving her awkward and lonely junior high school life behind, determined to become a normal girl with normal friends in high school. Glamorous, confident Mai Ouzuka is Renako’s total opposite: wealthy, outgoing, and a literal fashion model. Against the odds, the two girls form an immediate connection. Renako thinks she may have found the best friend of her dreams…until Mai’s romantic confession sends her into a tailspin. Renako wants to prove to Mai that being BFFs is better than being girlfriends, but Mai is dead set on convincing Renako that they’re destined to be lovers. Let the love games begin!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

node.description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

At school, Renako acts bright and sociable. However, while she enjoys talking with her classmates, this is only a front, and her "true self" is gloomy and negative.

In middle school, Renako declined an invitation to go out with her classmates, causing them to reject her. Renako spent the rest of middle school as a hikikomori as a result of this. Because of what happened to her in the past, she has trouble declining invitations and requests from her classmates.

**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

She is sometimes referred to as an "angel" because of her easygoing personality.  Sena's parents frequently leave her home to care for her two younger brothers, Kou-kun and Kii-kun. Although she loves her brothers, she grows resentful of the restrictions it places on her freedom as she is left to look after them on a more regular basis.

**Height:** 165 cm (5'5")

Satsuki is a blunt, serious, and headstrong person. Despite her beautiful appearance, she has a cold personality and an unapproachable aura that makes it difficult to connect with her.

~!Satsuki lives in a run-down apartment and works part-time to support her single mother.!~

**Height:** 167 cm (5'6")

Mai is gifted academically and athletically, and [Renako](https://anilist.co/character/196166/Amaori-Renako) describes her as the pinnacle of beauty. Mai is arrogant and forthright, owing to her status as the school's Madonna. Though she is polite in general, when she is alone with Renako, she is very open and persistent with her desires. She has a tendency to act on a whim. 

The day after meeting Mai, she confesses to Renako. Renako declines, but Mai persists. They both agree that when Mai wears her hair down, they are in "lovers mode," and when she ties it up, they are in "friends mode."

Mai's mother is an internationally renowned fashion designer, and Mai is one of her models. As a result, her family is very wealthy.

**Height:** 153 cm (5'0")

As the group's mascot, Kaho has a playful and fun personality. She enjoys making jokes and has the ability to control the mood of the group. She is referred to as "everyone's little sister" because of her childish personality.

~!Renako is later revealed to be Kaho's childhood friend. Renako was unable to remember who she was because her surname had been changed from Minaguchi to Koyanagi.!~
She is Renako's younger sister. She is a second-year junior high school student and a member of the badminton club. She is naturally extroverted and athletic, unlike her older sister.
